answer: The ripple is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the horizon. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the violet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
